question: Does the explicit homogeneous projector router realize the derived long-wavelength cone, including finite-band and degeneracy controls?

method.action: Exact zero-wave linearization of SS OPS 1 at kappa=pi/2, lambda=0: S_i psi(m)=P_i+ psi(m-e_i)+P_i- psi(m+e_i), U=S3 S2 S1. Memories homogeneous and stationary; this sector registration is not a new full dynamics.
method.units: ell=tau_c=1; q=k ell, phase=omega tau_c, group velocity in ell/tau_c. Neither conversion scale is predicted.
method.domain: Three fixed unit triads, both routing orders, all 26 normalized nonzero vectors in {-1,0,1}^3, radii 0.02/0.04/0.08/0.16. Full periodic zone [-pi,pi)^3 on 16 and 32 points per axis, including explicit corner and half-pi probes.
method.boundaries: Infinite homogeneous lattice via exact Fourier blocks; random periodic boxes 8^3 and 12^3 verify stencil and norm, not a continuum PDE extrapolation. No outgoing boundary or time integrator error.
method.initial_data: Triads fixed in configuration. Periodic random complex fields normalized globally using runtime PCG64 sampling stream; rotate all projectors about (1,2,3)/sqrt(14) by 0.731 rad.
method.solver: Compose displacement coefficients from the three explicit conditional shifts. Independently compare scipy matrix exponentials, analytic quaternion product and full real-space shifts/FFT. Principal positive quasiphase in [0,pi]; both eigenbands plus/minus phase, branch derivatives undefined at touchings.
method.tolerances: Matrices and norm <1e-10. Fine cone residual <0.02 and adjacent halving ratio <0.65 above roundoff floor. Derivative steps 1e-5,5e-6, reference and refinement <1e-6. Full details in each criterion.

hypotheses.prediction: Independent triads give nondegenerate Gram cones; collinear gives rank one. Order and directional asymmetry are finite-band terms, suppressed at small wave number.
Stencil/exponential disagreement, missing rank loss or residuals that fail to shrink falsify the implementation or the proposed leading cone within this benchmark.

controls.purpose: Expose routing signs, order errors and normalization errors
controls.method: Exponential product, independent quaternion algebra, periodic random field FFT and common projector rotation.

controls.purpose: Separate internal algebra from supplied propagation geometry
controls.method: Collinear triad, reversed gate order and opposite wavevectors; preserve exact nodal cases.

controls.purpose: Discriminate finite-band corrections and numerical errors
controls.method: Four prescribed radii, two derivative steps, nested full-zone grids and two periodic boxes. Do not fit coefficients to the same measured data.
